verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a code framework. It documents turn events that fire as user and assistant messages occur, and Pipecat Flows functions that move a conversation between nodes, so developers can attach actions to events in code. There is no evidence of a declarative rules or automation layer where users define trigger→action rules. Missing for 10: a documented rule-definition mechanism, a general event-to-action automation feature beyond turn and transcript events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Pipecat's turn events make it easy to collect both user and assistant messages as they occur.
